status: Retrospective exploratory; outcomes were already known before inference choices.
bootstrap: 2000 paired strand resamples with replacement; fixed trained model and fixed training-mean predictor; seed=751903
test: Studentized, null-centered nonparametric bootstrap; plus-one upper-tail Monte Carlo p=(1+exceedances)/(B+1)
intervals: two-sided 95% percentile paired-bootstrap CIs for R2, MSE, mean squared-loss improvement, and residual mean; quartile MSE intervals are pointwise descriptive only
secondary_metrics: held-out R2 = 1-SSE/SST using test mean only in denominator, RMSE, MAE, prediction-minus-target bias
historical_models: Descriptive comparison only; no paired tests or R2 inferred from old MSEs
limits: Conditional on one fitted model, one split and NUPACK-generated random strands. No across-seed or experimental-validation inference.
extension: Requested after initial LSTM inference. Retrospective family; no prospective confirmatory claim.
comparisons: Corrected LSTM vs training-mean predictor on its 100,000 test strands
Saved larger Transformer vs recovered training-mean predictor on its 100,000 historical evaluation strands
Larger Transformer vs corrected LSTM on common strands with unique canonical float32 labels; positive gain favors Transformer
extension_bootstrap: 2000 paired, studentized, null-centered resamples; seed 751904 for historical Transformer and 751905 for common cohort; 95% percentile intervals
multiplicity: Report raw bootstrap Monte Carlo p-values and Holm-adjusted values across these three retrospective comparisons.
matching: Canonicalize labels to original float32 training dtype; require uniqueness within the entire original million-strand dataset and CSV; exclude ambiguity; verify row IDs and labels against corrected-LSTM saved indices.
unavailable: No formal tests or inferred R2 for historical models without recoverable prediction-label pairs. Epoch loss curves are not independent test observations.
